_about: Single source of truth for the cut. scripts/build.mjs reads this to build assets/vo-cut.wav, assets/montage-cut.mp4 and both entry compositions. VO ranges are SOURCE-recording seconds; every other time is EDIT-timeline seconds (verified against a whisper pass on the cut VO).

vo._ranges: Cut inside measured silences: after 'this is for you.' / before 'We want to invite' / after 'with our team.' / before 'Now, this won't be a template'.

montage._shotStarts: Scene-detected cut points in the source reel (ffmpeg select gt(scene,0.3)). Shot n = [shotStarts[n], shotStarts[n+1]).
montage._skip: 13, 16, 29 = Sean talking to camera/mic (lips would not match the VO). 36 = old end card.

sections.vo: and one problem has been keeping you up at night,
We want to invite you to book a
free audit call with our team.
Now, this won't be a template or a checklist that's built for everyone.
This will just be your store and your problems. You'll
leave the call with a clear answer and a plan for what to fix first.
So if you're tired of courses ... this is the opposite of that.
